description: people.contactGroups.members.modify: POST v1/{+resourceName}/members:modify. Modify the members of a contact group owned by the authenticated user. The only system contact groups that can have members added are `contactGroups/myContacts` and `contactGroups/starred`. Other system contact groups are deprecated and can only have contacts removed. Runs as a background job; completion preserves vendor response fields and names the selected account. Pass pageToken for the next page. Parameters use exact vendor names. See workspace_api_coverage.md for body schemas, scopes and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use People Contact Groups Members Modify to modify the members of a contact group owned by the authenticated user. Acts on the selected connected Google account and returns Google's complete response, including pagination tokens when available. Supply vendor field names for filters, request bodies and updates.
